instructions: Type these into the centralized platform's proposal composer. Only the true duplicate cases should trigger a prior-art popup. Catalogue searches and tangential ideas must remain silent.

tests.type_this: What if customers who have returned five rentals without damage only pay a small deposit, instead of blocking the full amount every time?
tests.expected_title: Dynamic security deposits for trusted renters
tests.expected_message: Rohan Desai has already explored risk-adjusted deposits for trusted repeat renters. Check the pilot and implementation status before starting new work.

tests.type_this: Could we keep one neighbouring size on hold when we are not confident about how a brand fits, so the customer does not place two separate orders?
tests.expected_message: Ananya Sharma documented the same backup-size intervention. Review the category limits and margin guardrails.

tests.type_this: Search should hide outfits that cannot be inspected, cleaned and delivered before the customer’s wedding date, even if they are very popular.
tests.expected_title: Search ranking for rental availability, not catalogue popularity

tests.type_this: We should send pickup reminders using the customer’s event date and let them reschedule if courier capacity is available.

tests.type_this: Let’s build virtual try-on so customers can preview how a lehenga will drape.
tests.reason: Tangential to fit-confidence work but not the same intervention.

tests.type_this: Give shoppers ten percent off when they add three garments to the cart.
